title: Polydeukes config
description: Schema v2 (config as data) — equivalent to the runtime defineConfig() validator; the equivalence is enforced by a contract test.

$schema.description: IDE schema reference — accepted and ignored by the runtime validator.

languages.description: Language axis, first-class. Keys are user values ('typescript', 'python', ...).

protectedPaths.description: Raw protected path patterns — normalization happens at resolve time.

adapters.description: Adapter namespaces — keys are adapter names, values are each adapter's own settings object (contents not validated by the core schema).

disciplines.description: User-declared disciplines — validated data the covenant package compiles. Fully identical entries are copy-paste duplicates (by-id uniqueness is enforced by the runtime validator).

productionGlob.description: What counts as production source for this language.

testCmd.description: Shell command template that verifies the given scope — every literal {scope} token is substituted at resolve time.

logPath.description: Telemetry log path. Defaults to .polydeukes/roi.log when omitted. Must be non-empty after trimming.

witness.description: TTL witness settings — the agreed token and validity window (minutes) consumed by the covenant valve assembly (CONFIG-05).

token.description: The agreed phrase a human types alone on a message's first line — quoting it mid-sentence is a mention, not an invocation (COVENANT-15). Must be non-empty after trimming; the value itself is free.

ttlMinutes.description: Validity window in minutes from the user message's timestamp. Must be a finite number > 0.

disciplineId.description: Unique handle — telemetry label and verdict reason prefix. The three meta-covenant labels are reserved.

disciplineWhy.description: Prose rationale — never judged, and carried into the break message.

enforceLevel.description: The entry's own level. 'advise' records a break without stopping it; 'block' pins the entry at block. Composes with the surface's level, the lenient side winning; absent means advise; 'block' is the promotion rung.

discipline.description: One discipline entry — a judged entry (id + declare, optionally why and enforce), or a draft (id + why + draft: true, no declaration).

why.description: A draft's only body is its prose, so why is required and non-empty here.

draft.description: Marks an unpromoted entry — declared as prose, never judged, never recorded. Only the literal true exists; false would be dead data synonymous with absence.

declarationBody.description: Declaration family — one judgment written as data, in the grammar of the algebra declaration schema published beside this one, minus its 'discipline' key: the entry id is the declaration's name. The blocks' interiors are validated against that schema by the runtime validator.
